keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «펭귄은 몸의 특별한 특징 덕분에 추위를 견딘다(주제)» 와 «지방, 깃털, 협동으로 추위에 잘 대비되어 있다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (penguins survive the cold because of special body features) and the conclusion (fat, feathers, and teamwork prepare them for the cold). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Thick fat, oily feathers, and huddling

boxes.qko: 그 덕분에 펭귄은 어디서 살 수 있나요?
boxes.qen: Where can they live because of this?

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: They can survive the cold because their bodies have several special features.
to stay alive in a hard situation
special parts or qualities of something
penguins have a thick layer of fat under their skin.
a flat amount of something that covers another thing
many short feathers that overlap tightly, like tiles on a roof.
to cover part of something else
emperor penguins huddle together in large groups during storms.
penguins are well prepared for the cold.

qs.q: Why does cold water not reach a penguin’s skin?
qs.qko: 왜 차가운 물이 펭귄의 피부에 닿지 않나요?
opts: Because its feathers are covered with oil
Because penguins never go into the water
Because its legs have special blood vessels
evs: The feathers are covered with oil, which keeps cold water away from the skin.
This fat keeps body heat inside like a warm blanket.
Special blood vessels in their legs also help their feet lose very little heat.
They take turns standing in the warm middle and the cold outside of the group.
why: 깃털이 기름으로 덮여 있어서 차가운 물이 피부에 닿지 않게 해 준다고 했어요. 다리의 혈관은 발의 열에 관한 이야기예요.
The feathers are covered with oil, which keeps cold water away from the skin. The blood vessels are about heat in the feet.

qs.q: In "They take turns standing in the warm middle," what does "take turns" mean?
qs.qko: «They take turns standing in the warm middle» 에서 «take turns» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: Each one does it, one after another
All of them stay in one place forever
They run away from the group
evs: They take turns standing in the warm middle and the cold outside of the group.
In addition, emperor penguins huddle together in large groups during storms.
First, penguins have a thick layer of fat under their skin.
Many penguins live in very cold places, such as Antarctica, yet they stay warm.
why: 따뜻한 가운데와 추운 바깥쪽에 «번갈아» 선다고 했으니, take turns 는 차례대로 돌아가며 한다는 뜻이에요.
They stand in the warm middle and the cold outside, so «take turns» means each one does it one after another.

qs.q: Which two body features help penguins keep their body heat?
qs.qko: 펭귄이 체온을 지키도록 돕는 몸의 특징 두 가지는 무엇인가요?
opts: Fat under the skin and special blood vessels in the legs
evs: This fat keeps body heat inside like a warm blanket.
Many penguins live in very cold places, such as Antarctica, yet they stay warm.
Special blood vessels in their legs also help their feet lose very little heat.
Second, they have many short feathers that overlap tightly, like tiles on a roof.
why: 지방이 담요처럼 체온을 안에 가두고, 다리의 특별한 혈관이 발에서 열이 아주 조금만 빠져나가게 한다고 했어요. 두 문장을 함께 봐야 해요.
The fat keeps body heat inside like a blanket, and the blood vessels in the legs help the feet lose very little heat. You need both sentences.

ends: Some penguins live near the equator. How do they stay cool?
적도 근처에 사는 펭귄도 있어요. 어떻게 시원하게 지낼까요?
How do polar bears stay warm in the Arctic?

write.src: “I think <u>penguins are great team players</u> because <u>they take turns in the cold</u>.”

write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.

write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», use a fact from the text to make your reason clear. (e.g. because they huddle together)
